Package org.aeonbits.owner

Annotation Type Config.CollectionConverterClass

Enclosing interface:
Config
@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(METHOD) @Documented public static @interface Config.CollectionConverterClass
Specifies a Converter class to convert the property value into the Collection returned by the method, in a single step.

This differs from Config.ConverterClass, which converts one element at a time after OWNER has split the property value: here the raw value is handed over untouched and the converter is responsible for the whole process, including honouring Config.Separator and Config.TokenizerClass if it wants to. It is therefore the way to opt out of the built-in tokenization, for instance when the property holds a single indivisible document such as JSON, or when the collection must be of a type OWNER cannot instantiate on its own.

The annotated method must return a Collection; using it on any other return type raises an UnsupportedOperationException when the property is read.

Since:
2.0.0
